serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral Ecclesiasticalot FF: Hello there. Oh, it’s him. But why him? With what is he supposed to torture me with? He’s usually rather friendly and never scared me in any way. #Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry Ecclesiasticalot FF: What? Aren’t you going to return a greeting? You: S-Sorry, I was lost in thoughts. #Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral You: Can we just start fishing? I’m not in the mood for some weird mind games. Ecclesiasticalot FF: “Weird mind games” are precisely why you are here for, son. Maybe you still don’t realize it, but they are an essential part of this process. You: But why?! I don’t remember anything after the fact anyway! Ecclesiasticalot FF: You complain way beyond what's necessary. Just put a little trust in others. You: Whatever. Just start the sermon already if you have to. #Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry Ecclesiasticalot FF: Unfortunately, but no sermon would be enough for you to change your sinful path! You: MY sinful path? What the hell? Ecclesiasticalot FF: Stop pretending you don’t know. You have an unhealthy relationship with that sinful object in your room! You: Sinful object? Do you mean {f_botName}? You: That’s ironic, if she’s an object aren’t you an “object” too? Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was created to do good. Give out sacraments, do charity work, and help the lost, but you already know that. Ecclesiasticalot FF: That thing in your room isn’t a real person. You know well that your way of living is unnatural. You: And what do you know about living? Ecclesiasticalot FF: You still don’t get it, do you? It’s all in your head. My form has nothing to do with your doubts.
